html:
SMTO-GML-0018 — SMTO doesn't support that kind of Gmail change

GUID: 17106cc8-b7a9-4fe2-b450-1a175efe4a68
Slug: gmail-mutation-invalid
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to make a bulk change to emails that it doesn't know how to do. It stopped before changing anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO for one of these changes: archive, mark as read, mark as unread, star, unstar, mark as spam, move to Trash, restore from Trash, add a label or remove a label. These are the bulk email changes SMTO can make.
  2. Ask for a new preview of the emails to change, check it, then approve it. The earlier preview was used up by the failed attempt.
  3. If you need something else, such as deleting emails forever, ask SMTO for that as a separate request. Other actions use a different, more careful path than bulk label changes.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows a preview for the supported change and, after you approve, reports the emails as changed.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; this may point to a problem in SMTO itself.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Gmail label-change dispatch received an operation outside the supported set (archive, mark_read, mark_unread, star, unstar, mark_spam, trash, untrash, add_label, remove_label).

What this means

  • Label-change dispatch receives an operation outside its supported named mutation actions. Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.

Why this can happen

  • Label-change dispatch receives an operation outside its supported named mutation actions.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the selected action with the currently advertised Gmail operation schema.

How to fix it

  • GmailService._label_changes raises gmail_mutation_invalid for any operation not in its mapping. The GmailBatchModifyPayload schema already restricts operation to the supported values, so this indicates a direct service call or schema drift; use one of: archive, mark_read, mark_unread, star, unstar, mark_spam, trash, untrash, add_label, remove_label, then run a fresh gmail.preview_modify.
  • Correct the fields against the supported Gmail operation schema.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported intended mutation maps to the correct label/provider operation.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
